_doc: Lumi's six designs (systems/designs.gd; looks in PatchModel.VARIANTS, add-ons in art/models/aurora/designs.glb). A design is a set of pieces (data/cosmetics.json, pieces with set = this id): the player wears it by finding its pieces in the world (design spec section 13); nothing here unlocks from a counter or a cost. buff: the set's small bonus, applied only while EVERY piece of the set is worn: stat = an Economy stat id ("*.work_rate" = every robot type), research_speed (Research), or streak_grace (cleaning streak hold time); amount = +fraction. Off with flags.designs_looks_only. A mixed look gives no bonus. The starting design (aurora, every piece a starter) has no buff: a bonus that switched off when the player wore a found piece would read as a penalty; only a set completed from found pieces gives one. State: the worn look in flags.lumi_style, its base design in flags.patch_skin; found pieces in the save's global section.

designs.name: Aurora
designs.desc: The seed-keeper fresh from the ark: pearl paint, cyan eyes, an orange fin.

designs.name: Bolt
designs.desc: Hazard-yellow plating, heavy shoulder pads and a spare gear for luck.

designs.name: Sprout
designs.desc: Moss-green and growing a seedling of its own.

designs.name: Pixel
designs.desc: Red and white, all smiles, with a butterfly that won't leave.

designs.name: Nova
designs.desc: Gunmetal, violet light and a holo screen always open.

designs.name: Patch
designs.desc: Medic cross, tool box, and a case of spares for any bot in need.
